title: RRB NTPC CEN 06/2025 Graduate Level CBT II Exam Date 2026
intro: Short Information : Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released the CBT-II Exam Date for the Non Technical Popular Categories NTPC Graduate Level posts. RRB has invited huge number of vacancies for NTPC Graduate Level post recruitment during the 16 March 2026 to 27 March 2026. There were 5,810 posts were called for the hiring of RRB NTPC Graduate Level in various trades. The CBT-II examination is going to be conducted on 10 July 2026. Candidates who qualified for this CBT I examination can check their RRB NTPC CEN 06/2025 Graduate Level Exam Date 2026 from the link given below.
importantDates: Correction / Modified Form : 30 November 2025 to 09 December 2025
Exam City Details : 10 Days Before Exam
applicationFee: Fee Refund (After Appearing in Stage I Exam)
Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
